finding.trigger: A valid native scene with no accepted timetable; particularly an existing daylight target followed by a current night target/day/clock transition while prayer data is unavailable.
chain: beginSkyScene adds sky-pending but leaves the previous solar CSS values intact.
render calls paintCelestialWithoutTimetable and returns before atmosphere/paint when model is absent.
The helper updates only lunar properties, then removes sky-pending for the whole atmospheric layer.
The Sun body and corona use retained inline --sunbodyamt/--sunamt; a fresh document instead uses their zero-opacity CSS fallbacks.
finding.consequence: Current lunar/sky publication can expose stale solar presence/colour/geometry, or postpone a warranted fresh daytime Sun until timetable acceptance. This is not proof of rapid steady strobing.
finding.narrowRequirement: Publish a current solar presentation from the existing admitted physical Sun/solar owner before exposing those layers, without waiting for timetable/network or adding a second ephemeris. Preserve the R0024 profile/geometry/opacity contract; do not suppress the whole card.
finding.missingDiscriminator: Current tests assert Moon readiness and pending removal but do not seed prior solar properties. A future authorized focused source control should seed a bright prior Sun then supply a current below-horizon no-timetable scene, and a fresh daytime no-timetable case, and assert the actual solar sinks before reveal.
